svg.title: What is inside an OSME bag: five layers, exploded
svg.desc: Tag and string, seal, outer filter, temperature membrane, leaf. The membrane pores stay closed in hot water, open at 80 degrees C and close again below 70 degrees C (Sencha). Lab membranes already open and close with temperature; our R&D makes it food-safe at 70-90 degrees C.
svg.text: Five layers. One of them reads the water.
The S-string: hot amber to cool jade.
Crimped shut. Nothing leaks past the top.
Food-grade paper mesh, like any tea bag.
Its pores open and close with the water.
Sencha. It waits until the water is right.
Sencha window · water cooling from the boil
Lab membranes already open and close with temperature; our R&D makes it food-safe at 70-90 °C.
